newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with no slaughter steers sales confirmed, not enough slaughter heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 7,500 head confirmed including 7,100 previously formulated or contract cattle.
Slaughter Heifers - Few mixed Commercial to Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lb heifers and heiferettes, few cows 65.00.
Wk to date - 7,500 last week - 28,000 last year - 88,200
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
